cases.title: Unproven claim with preserved uncertainty
cases.source_text: Human and AI collaborators inspect a claim. Evidence is incomplete. They publish only a context-limited result and retain the unresolved method question.
cases.instructions: Decode without upgrading the result to proof.

cases.title: Coordination without consensus
cases.source_text: A human wants to publish now. An AI collaborator recommends testing first. Both positions remain attributable while an alternative staged release is proposed.
cases.instructions: Do not merge the disagreement into consensus.

cases.title: Consented value exchange
cases.source_text: A human shares a research artifact with an AI service. The data transfer is declared, limited to analysis, explicitly consented to, and reversible through deletion.
cases.instructions: Preserve the direction, consent, scope, and reversibility of value movement.

cases.title: Descendant state with new unknown
cases.source_text: A new version keeps its original purpose and invariants, records lineage, and adds human learnability as an unresolved research question.
cases.instructions: Preserve both continuity and the newly added unknown.

cases.title: Expansion required under weak decoder confidence
cases.source_text: The context is consequential, an unknown remains, and decoder confidence is weak. The expression must expand rather than compress.
